newsitem.title: USA: Whitman to name Cushing head bottler unit - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Whitman to name Cushing head bottler unit - WSJ.

text.p: Whitman Corp was expected to name Robert Cushing as president of its Pepsi-Cola General Bottlers unit, the Wall Street Journal said in its electronic edition on Wednesday.
William Frago, the unit's previous president and chief executive, left the post on January 16, saying he was "wrongfully terminated."
A deal could be announced as early as Wednesday, the paper said, citing people close to the company.
Cushing, 45, was now executive vice president of marketing and strategic planning at the unit, the paper said.
